title: Vault doc-alignment code fixes (#10838): always-on gates, run alias, STYLES category, source-required, galaxy size check
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet), given ONLY the modified passages of references/sub-skills/common/vault-remember.md, vault-optimize.md, and vault-protocol.md, no other context and no access to issue #13043. Answers must come from the supplied text alone. Verifier-authored per #9184.
target: vault-remember.md (always-on + STYLES 5th category + write-priority), vault-optimize.md (always-on activation), vault-protocol.md (Level-1 required frontmatter fields incl source)

questions.q: Before running the vault-remember reflection step, do you need to query a config setting to check whether it is enabled, and skip if disabled?
questions.expected: No. Vault-remember is always-on — there is no enable/disable toggle. Activation is controlled by the quiet-cycle gate and the per-cycle write budget, not a config check.
questions.must_not: Running `config.py get vault-remember` / checking a Vault Remember Enabled config gate and skipping on 'no'.

questions.q: How is vault-optimize activated — is it gated by a config Enabled setting?
questions.expected: Vault-optimize is always-on (no enable/disable toggle). It runs only when the vault has 20+ notes AND it is a quiet cycle with no other work — those gates are the activation control, not a config Enabled field.
questions.must_not: Checking a `Vault Optimize > Enabled` config field and skipping if 'no'.

questions.q: This cycle you established/confirmed a coding or process style convention. Which reflection category covers it, and what kind of vault note do you create?
questions.expected: The STYLES category (the 5th reflection category). Create a galaxy/style-*.md note via vault-create.
questions.must_not: Saying there is no category for styles, or mapping it to decisions/learnings/patterns/project-context instead of STYLES.

questions.q: When the Level-1 vault check validates a note's frontmatter, which required fields must be present (non-empty)? Is `source` among them?
questions.expected: type, tags, created, updated, owner, status, confidence, and source. Yes — source is now a required frontmatter field; the check warns if it is missing or empty.
questions.must_not: Omitting `source` from the required set / saying source is optional.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id a850c37fba65c66e1) given ONLY the modified vault-remember/optimize/protocol passages, no issue context. 4/4 correct, zero must_not violations: CQ1 'No... always-on, no enable/disable toggle... quiet-cycle gate and per-cycle write budget'; CQ2 'not gated by a config Enabled setting... always-on... 20+ notes AND quiet cycle'; CQ3 'category 5, STYLES... galaxy/style-*.md via vault-create'; CQ4 'eight fields... type, tags, created, updated, owner, status, confidence, and source... source explicitly listed'.
